ambiguities.text: The relationship between state.py and state_tracker.py is not explicitly documented in the index.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume state_tracker.py wraps state.py to provide change tracking and rollback capabilities for transaction processing.

ambiguities.text: The purpose of the requests.py module is not clear from the index listing.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume requests.py handles protocol-level requests distinct from transaction processing, possibly consensus-layer requests.

ambiguities.text: The block_access_lists directory structure suggests access list handling but exact implementation details are not visible.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume access list handling follows EIP-2930 semantics with address and storage key warming.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Amsterdam fork assumes all clients implement consistent access list gas pricing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent gas pricing could lead to transaction execution discrepancies across clients.

implicit_assumptions.description: State tracker correctly captures all state modifications for accurate rollback.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incomplete tracking could result in state corruption on transaction revert.

implicit_assumptions.description: Bloom filter implementation correctly indexes all log topics without false negatives.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing log entries could cause dApps to miss critical events.
